messages:
maria (People Ops): Heads up — contractor Samir Patel (samir@vendorco) last day 2026-04-02. Need access offboarding, final invoicing timeline, vendor termination note, and any data/archive needs. @it-ops @security @julia please advise.

arjun (Eng): Which repos/projects did he have access to? He worked on realtime-inference and some infra helpers.

maria (People Ops): Short list: infra-realtime repo, batch-pipelines repo, GCP project redwood-sandbox-samir, and a few GitHub deploy keys. No company laptop (personal device), but we issued an SSH key for CI. I'll DM the full asset list.

it-ops: I'll create the deprovision ticket and schedule the disables for 2026-04-02 10:00 PT. Will remove Okta/Google Workspace, GitHub org membership, AWS/GCP IAM roles, and Slack. Ticket created: DEVOPS-6218.

security: Please snapshot relevant logs before account removal. Also need to rotate any shared keys and run a quick sweep for service accounts the contractor may have touched.

it-ops: Plan & quick commands I'm going to run: 
```
# disable okta user
oktactl users deactivate --email samir@vendorco
# remove from github org
gh api -X DELETE /orgs/redwood/memberships/samir
# rotate aws keys for shared roles
aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id <id> --status Inactive
```
Will follow up in the ticket with logs.

julia (Recruiting): I'll confirm final contractor paperwork and invoice ETA. Agency said final invoice expected by 2026-04-04; please confirm payout window once approved.

maria (People Ops): COBRA check — since this is a contractor engagement (vendor), COBRA not applicable, but we still need a vendor termination letter and to update benefits/vendor ledger. I'll draft and send the termination note today.

sre-bot: Deprovision ticket DEVOPS-6218 created and assigned to it-ops. Status: open. Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-02 09:45 PT.

arjun (Eng): One more — any telemetry or model checkpoints we should archive before we remove the GCP project?

it-ops: Good call. We'll snapshot GCS buckets (gs://samir-realtime-checkpoints) and export to internal-archive/project-samir on 2026-04-01 11:00 PT to avoid last-minute blocking.

maria (People Ops): Wrapping up: it-ops -> run deprovision (DEVOPS-6218) on 4/2, security -> snapshot logs & rotate keys, recruiting -> finalize invoice/payout details, People Ops -> vendor termination letter + tracker update. Reply with :thumbsup: when tasks are complete or if you need anything else.
